post.summary: Join waiting room using invite code
post.description: JWT user must differ from host. Rate limit <=10 attempts/user/min. Lock room atomically; enforce two slots. Second join starts room and sets play_deadline=server now+24h. Existing opponent retry returns current snapshot; host self-join conflicts.

post.summary: Replay and accept one solved trace per participant
post.description: Body <=262144 bytes UTF-8; 1..5000 valid actions. Canonical map from room. Count moves/pushes/valid undos as one; no blocked/empty undo/post-solved actions. Restart resets local attempt and is absent from trace. Existing same owner/UUID/digest receipt returns duplicate even after expiry; changed digest conflicts. Finalizer atomically rechecks server now < play_deadline and unique(room,user), inserts receipt and computes outcome. Smaller verified_steps wins; equality draw. Does not update campaign progress or personal leaderboard. Require verified user claims and room membership in handler, not verify_jwt alone. Publishable key or service secret without user JWT cannot authenticate a player. Admin finalizer actor comes only from verified claims; client cannot execute finalizer.
